_how: The prediction rules of eurelaps_lung (the default; analysis/results.md 7d, 7f): written by main_calibrate.py (--make-default), read by config.py ({"rule": "collapse"}) and predict.estimate(). Another rule file: main_predict.py --params FILE, or the environment variable EURELAPS_RULES=FILE for a whole process.

q0._how: log10 q0 = a + b * collapse %, q0 = p0 / E of the same fits (fitE_netgen, server 2026-11-18: q0 from the table of analysis/results.md 7d, collapse % from each patient's collapsed lung); an estimate shown before a run, the run itself searches q0 (collapse % given) or takes p0
